passive.name: League of Draven
passive.description: Draven gains his fans' Adoration when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or tower. Killing enemy champions grants Draven bonus gold based on how much Adoration he has.

spells.name: Spinning Axe
spells.description: Draven readies a Spinning Axe, causing his next Attack to deal an additional physical damage and ricochet into the air. If Draven catches it, he readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can hold two Spinning Axes at once.

spells.name: Blood Rush
spells.description: Draven becomes Ghosted, gains % Move Speed decaying over seconds and % Attack Speed for seconds. When Draven catches a Spinning Axe, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.

spells.name: Whirling Death
spells.description: Draven hurls two massive axes that deal physical damage. Upon hitting a champion or Recasting, they reverse direction and return to Draven. The axes deal % less damage for each enemy hit, down to a minimum of %. If Whirling Death would leave an enemy champion with less health than % of Draven's current League of Draven stacks (), he will execute them.
